thread:
taylor: hey team, excited to start tomorrow. quick onboarding blockers: 1) my phone is in repair so i can't use authenticator for a couple weeks. 2) vendor for a demo requires older USB driver that wants kernel-level access on mac. what are our paths?
alex-it: welcome Taylor! for MFA, we can fast-issue a loaner hardware key (YubiKey) or short-lived VPN cert after HR approves an accommodation. which do you prefer?
taylor: loaner key would be easiest. can we get it expedited? i'm in a different timezone so delays are rough.
procurement: we have express shipping for loaners. reply with a DM for address and mark "expedite". note customs can slow things depending on country.
mira-security: re: kernel driver — we don't allow unsigned kernel modules on company devices. Options: vendor-signed driver + security review, an isolated loaner VM, or a VLAN-separated loaner laptop. Which vendor/model?
taylor: vendor is MediComm v2.0, they specifically list a legacy serial driver. I'd prefer an isolated loaner laptop if possible.
alex-it: we can image a loaner with a minimal admin to support vendor install and put it on a restricted VLAN. you'll sign a temporary device agreement and we add network ACLs.
onboard-bot: automated note: InfoSec and Data Handling training assigned on day 2. Phishing simulation inclusion occurs after 7 days by default. Accommodation requests must be filed to HR to exclude from phishsim.
hr: if you need an MFA or phishsim accommodation, please submit: https://redwood.example/hr/accommodation and cc security@redwood.example. Processing target is 48 business hours. Include any supporting doc if comfortable.
taylor: filed the form and cc'd security. DMing address for the key now. how fast after HR approval for phishsim opt-out?
mira-security: once HR approves, security will mark the account excluded within one business day. if you include a note about the duration we can set a clear expiry.
procurement: got the DM, ordering express loaner YubiKey now and co-shipping a USB-C serial adapter per your note. tracking should be sent to your email.
taylor: amazing, thank you everyone. one last q: can we delay the interactive phishing module if i'm opted out? i still want the compliance training but the simulated clicks module triggers anxiety.
hr: yes we can separate the modules and move the phishing practical exercise until you're comfortable. put that preference in the accommodation form and we'll adjust deadlines.
taylor: will do. thanks again 64f
